messages.author: 8129606756857cb3
messages.subject: Add 'min', 'max', etc. arguments to updateSliderInput?
parts:
Hi,

I have a small feature request. I'm trying to build a small filter that updates based on the type of R object selected: if we select a factor, then we get the levels (displayed through updateCheckboxGroupInput), if we select something numeric, then we get a slider with a range determined by the min / max of that vector. Unfortunately, this functionality isn't available in updateSliderInput -- is it by any chance on the way?

Thanks,
-Kevin

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: Add 'min', 'max', etc. arguments to updateSliderInput?
parts:
You can do that easily by modifying updateSliderInput as shown below. You can use the ... arguments to update any argument that is accepted by sliderInput. This is untested, but I believe it should work without any trouble, since all you are doing is sending along more parameters in the message payload.

updateSliderInput = function(session, inputId, label = NULL, value = NULL, ...){
  message <- dropNulls(list(label=label, value=value, ...))
  session$sendInputMessage(inputId, message)

}

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Add 'min', 'max', etc. arguments to updateSliderInput?
parts:
The limitation here is that the jslider widget that used on the client side only supports changing the value of the slider, and not the min or max or other properties. This means that updating the other properties will require removing and recreating the slider. Actually, this is something that we tried to do earlier on - I don't recall the details right now but there was some issue with the re-initialization of the slider. At any rate, this is something that we hope to have implemented in a future version of Shiny.

-Winston
